Privacy & Compliance

Aether stores your data for this workspace only. Agents never submit an application, send an email, or share your profile without an explicit approval.

No Gmail account connected. Manage or disconnect a connected Gmail account from the Email Command Center.

You can correct your profile details from the Profile tab at any time. There is no self-service “export all data” or “delete all data” feature yet; contact us to request a full data export or deletion and we will process it manually.
